description: Engine-only rename of a table used by saved queries. On a writable copy of the base fixture QDepT (SELECT ID, A FROM T;) and QJoinT (SELECT T.ID, U.V FROM T INNER JOIN U ON T.ID = U.TID;) are created and read. TableDef T's Name is set to T2 (Name and DBEngine.Errors read); then both queries' SQL are read, both are opened and read, and SELECT * is opened on T2 and on T. TableDefs are listed. After Close and reopen both queries' SQL are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
